name: myCHEF.ae SEO Operating Standard
purpose: Single machine-readable contract for every live URL. Prevents self-inflicted SEO: cannibalisation, exact-match heading farms, cheap modifiers, duplicate modules, invented job titles, and guessed You May Also Like lists. Does not create demand and does not replace a keyword-volume tool.

how_to_use.cms_or_cursor: Load pages[path]. Write title, H1, meta, schema, robots, canonical and modules from that object only.
how_to_use.ai_writer: Prepend agent_preamble to every generation prompt. Pass the page object as context.
how_to_use.human_editor: If a draft violates qa_gates or invariants, it does not ship.
how_to_use.conflict_rule: This file is the shipping contract. Older JSON architecture files are not allowed to retarget a locked primary.

invariants.one_intent_one_owner: Each exact commercial query has exactly one owner URL. That owner is intent_owner.primary_keyword.
invariants.md_lock_wins: The 19 Aug keyword map wins any fight with later architecture files.
invariants.primary_placement: Title, H1, first 100 words, one subheading. Nowhere else as exact match on purpose.
invariants.subkeywords: Inside sentences only. Cap 12 on commercial and location pages, 8 on guides and posts (owner directive 2026-08-26: 10–15 relevant keywords per page where justified, never forced). If the sentence exists only to carry the term, delete the sentence.
invariants.no_keyword_headings: Do not rebuild the 161 exact-match H2 farm.
invariants.siblings_are_next_steps: You May Also Like must survive: would this buyer click that card next? Folder membership is not enough.
invariants.locations_sample: Three relevant areas on the page. Full 15 only in the footer and on /locations.
invariants.household_cluster: Do not put /private-chef-dubai/{pricing,our-chefs,privacy-security,quality-training,how-your-plan-works} in global nav.
invariants.recruitment_boxed: private chef jobs / executive chef dubai live only on /become-a-mychef.
invariants.no_cheap: Never cheap, affordable, budget in title, H1 or opening.
invariants.no_invented_titles: No kids nutrition chef, corporate retainer, booking protection, mystery dining, family feast package as H1s.
invariants.no_experience_years: Chef years-of-experience claims are not evidenced.
invariants.volume_before_new_urls: Do not mint a new spoke because a term exists in a list. Check demand first.
invariants.read_aloud: If it sounds written for a machine, it does not ship.

agent_preamble:
You are writing or reviewing a page on mychef.ae.
You must open the page object for this URL in myCHEF-AE-SEO-STANDARD.json and obey it.

Non-negotiable:
1. Use only intent_owner.primary_keyword as the ranking target.
2. Put that primary in title, H1, first 100 words, and one subheading. Not in every heading.
3. Subkeywords go inside sentences. Never as H2s. Cap eight. Delete any sentence that exists only to hold a term.
4. Do not use another URL's primary_keyword in this page's title or H1.
5. Render internal_linking.siblings exactly. Do not invent a You May Also Like list.
6. Do not use any term in invariants.banned_terms.
7. Do not claim chef years of experience. Only name Ahmed Al-Rashid, Marco Rossi, Layla Hassan, Matteo Moretti.
8. Do not write cheap/affordable/budget. This brand does not convert that traffic.
9. Read the draft aloud. If it sounds like it was written for Google, rewrite until it sounds like a host briefing a chef.
10. If this file and any older keyword spreadsheet disagree, this file wins for technical/linking; the locked primary in this file already reflects the 19 Aug map.

If the URL is not in pages[], stop. Add it through change_control before writing copy.

new_url_requires: A live product or evidenced chef/menu behind the URL.
A primary keyword that is not already owned in pages[].intent_owner.primary_keyword.
Sibling list of real next steps (not the hub featured-five).
Add the URL to sitemap only after robots/canonical are set.
forbidden_new_urls: Thin location pages for every compound (Damac Hills, Tilal Al Ghaf, Meydan) until demand is proven.
Cuisine private-chef pages without a named, approved chef and a menu.
A second pricing URL or a second our-chefs URL.

validation_checks.assert: No two indexable pages share the same primary_keyword.
If primary_keyword is set, title contains it or an approved hand-tuned equivalent.
title/h1 do not contain banned terms.
A page is not its own sibling.
If redirect_to is set, in_sitemap is false.
Household duplicate modules are noindex or redirected.
/chefs/* primary is not a recruitment query.
